cause: Closure authority was validated field-by-field after path resolution without binding lexical canonical paths, container shapes, and frontmatter identity to one repository-derived identity; JSON byte limits also did not bound parser recursion.
prevention: Require list-shaped authority, direct canonical claim and unit files, primary-root-only relative worktrees, path-derived task and unit identity, bounded JSON recursion handling, and a fail-closed Stop wrapper; preserve each behavior with source and packaged-template regression tests.
summary: Released-claim authority, claim and unit aliases, conflicting work identity, linked-root shadow paths, and deeply nested accepted-watch JSON could cross or escape canonical closure boundaries.
title: Bind closure authority to canonical paths, shapes, and bounded parsing
